meta.name: ai-csv-excel-merger
meta.description: 资料整理助手适合运营、产品、销售、software在用户提出“这份材料重点是什么”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成合并方案、字段冲突清单、处理结果说明。

copy.tagline: 合并CSV和Excel文件，自动处理字段冲突
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要合并多个表格并处理字段不一致
copy.tagline_en: Merge CSV and Excel files, auto-resolve field conflicts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often merge multiple spreadsheets and handle field inconsistencies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你整理资料、合并表格、列出字段冲突，并给出处理结果和下一步行动。
howto.when: 当你问“这份材料重点是什么”，或需要整理文档、表格、会议记录等资料时触发。

say.text: 帮我合并这两个CSV文件，列出字段冲突。
say.note: Claude会生成合并方案和冲突清单。

say.text: 整理这份会议记录，提取行动项。
say.note: Claude会输出结构摘要和下一步动作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you organize materials, merge tables, list field conflicts, and provide processing results and next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "What is the key point of this material" or need to organize documents, tables, meeting notes, etc.

say_en.text: Merge these two CSV files and list field conflicts.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a merge plan and conflict list.

say_en.text: Organize this meeting minutes and extract action items.
say_en.note: Claude will output a structured summary and next steps.
